title: Writing "Woman, Be Wise" with a verse from Bonnie
summary: She explains how "Woman, Be Wise" came about and that Bonnie wrote one verse.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: That "Woman, Be Wise," that's a good tune. That's a nice tune.
Do you remember when you wrote that?
See, I wrote that because I had to new songs and I couldn't get no -- I never did get no words got the words for me and got the words for me, too. I played and
sang the words for me. I say -- I never thought of it. I'll make ______ sing that verse for you.
(Unintelligible). She sings the verse ______. She can sing just like Bonnie do.
I had ______ dancing one day with me ______ Bonnie, she danced real good until she got pregnant. Yeah, (inaudible).
Oh, did Bonnie write those words to "Woman, Be Wise?"
Yeah, but see, she wrote that verse she got.
No, that "Woman, Be Wise" is my song. I wrote it.
